name: Sports
description: Football and Formula 1 for every person: favourite teams, live scores, goals and full time announced, standings and the Grand Prix calendar, with widgets appearing when needed or when you come closer.
capabilities: Favourite teams per person or for the whole home (Serie A, B, European cups, main leagues, national teams)
Continuous background watch: kick-off, goals, red cards and full time with widget and voice announcement
Formula 1: session calendar, race in progress, results and driver and constructor standings
Voice questions: «how did Napoli do?», «Serie A table», «when is the next F1 race?»
Widgets recalled when you come close to the screen if nothing more important is showing
No key needed: public sources, cached data and no personal data sent
